Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Each frame the system walks its pending requests, one per entity, each an optional boolean (a value byte and a has-value byte). For a request with a value: if the entity has no esv::character::CanOpenDoorsOverrideComponent it adds one, otherwise it takes the existing one; either way it stores the request's value in the component's byte (CanOpenDoors). The request list is emptied at the end of the update. The requests come from Osiris SetCanOpenDoorsOverride(character, value) (the call's name; the link through LEGACY_SetCanOpenDoorsOverride rests on the layout's EoCServer.dll reading, not on bg3_dx11.exe).
